description: This file defines the interface for a channel equalizer class used in radio signal processing, including nested classes for channel estimation and methods for equalization and support checking.

classes.name: channel_equalizer
classes.description: Interface for a channel equalizer that mitigates radio channel effects and reverts layer mapping.

classes.name: ch_est_list
classes.description: Nested class providing access to channel estimation data, including channel coefficients and resource counts.

methods.name: is_supported
methods.description: Checks if the given number of ports and layers are supported by the equalizer.

methods.name: equalize
methods.description: Performs MIMO channel equalization, combining Tx-Rx paths, estimating noise, and reverting layer mapping.
